title: Add schema‑based request validation middleware
description: Introduces a built‑in middleware that validates request params, query strings and bodies against JSON‑Schema definitions. It returns a 400 response with detailed error messages when validation fails, removing the need for repetitive manual checks and improving API reliability.
testCases: Valid request matching the schema proceeds to the handler
Invalid request body returns 400 with a list of schema violations
Invalid query parameters return 400 with appropriate error details
Middleware integrates with existing error‑handling flow without breaking other middleware
acceptance: When the middleware is registered with a route, any request that does not conform to the supplied JSON‑Schema is rejected with a 400 status and a JSON payload describing the validation errors; compliant requests are passed unchanged to the next handler. All existing tests continue to pass and new tests cover the scenarios above.
reason: Ensures API contracts are enforced centrally, reduces boiler‑plate validation code, prevents malformed data from reaching business logic, and aligns the framework with production‑grade security and reliability standards.
